mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market prices in sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic distress and potential central bank stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through improved corporate earnings visibility.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 100), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as manufacturing growth supports corporate profitability and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through improved business sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Higher payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as market participants price in sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 1-year average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals strong residential demand and economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through sustained consumer spending growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A dovish monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) combined with disinflation (CPIAUCSL < 235) signals supportive conditions for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through reduced risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25 and CPIAUCSL < 235.
